claims.statement: Charles d'Amboise asks Florence for Leonardo. The republic grants a leave of limited length that is later extended.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Florentine records and French correspondence.
